The staged `patch.diff` is unrelated test-only commit `6fafbce81a63a0f09527a7305a98ed3e17c042b0`; the matching code fix present in local history is `ce684dd00` (`fetch map after DGifGetImageDesc()`).

classification.classification_note: The observed memory error is a stale-pointer read of a freed `ColorMapObject`: libvips caches `file->Image.ColorMap` in local `map`, giflib frees that object while parsing the next image descriptor, and libvips later reads `map->ColorCount`.

bug_description.normalized: The staged witness is a 50-byte malformed GIF-like file that begins `47 49 46 38` (`GIF8`), so libvips routes it into `gifload`. During open, giflib's `DGifGetScreenDesc()` consumes bytes `20 20 20 20` at offsets 4-7 and materializes `GifFile->SWidth = GifFile->SHeight = 0x2020 = 8224`. Header scanning then sees `0x2c` at offset 14, enters `vips_foreign_load_gif_scan_image()`, and `DGifGetImageDesc()` parses first-frame header bytes `20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 99`; those bytes set left=top=width=height=8224, and packed byte `0x99` makes giflib allocate a 4-entry local `ColorMapObject` from the 12 following bytes. That first frame is rejected by the bad-frame-size guard because `Left + Width` and `Top + Height` exceed the logical screen size 8224x8224, so the scan returns before the `gif->has_colour` test and before `vips_foreign_load_gif_code_next()` drains image data. `vips_foreign_load_gif_header()` ignores that `-1`, later consumes the leftover `0xff` at offset 36 as a wrong record, and then reaches the second `0x2c` at offset 37. On that later image, libvips snapshots the still-live prior `file->Image.ColorMap` into local `map` before calling `DGifGetImageDesc()`. giflib then frees the previous `GifFile->Image.ColorMap`; the second descriptor bytes `20 00 20 00 20 00 20 00 20` produce left=top=width=height=32, and because packed byte `0x20` has no local color table, `GifFile->Image.ColorMap` becomes NULL. The second frame now passes the size guard on the same 8224x8224 logical screen, `gif->has_colour` is still false because the first scan exited before any colour check, and the grayscale-detection loop reads `map->ColorCount` through the freed pointer. AddressSanitizer reports the resulting heap-use-after-free READ of size 4 at `libvips/foreign/gifload.c:463`.

source.description: During GIF open, giflib consumes the witness logical-screen width and height bytes and materializes `GifFile->SWidth` and `GifFile->SHeight`, the earliest project-side tainted state later used by both frame-size guards.
source.value_from: After the `GIF8` stamp, witness bytes at offsets 4-7 are `20 20 20 20`; `DGifGetWord()` reads little-endian `0x2020` twice, so `GifFile->SWidth = GifFile->SHeight = 8224`.

tainted_value_origin.description: On the first frame, this call parses the descriptor bytes after offset 14, materializes descriptor geometry, and sees packed byte `0x99`, which makes giflib allocate `file->Image.ColorMap`, the heap object later cached into stale `map`.

sink.description: ASan crash site. The grayscale-detection loop reads `map->ColorCount` through a local pointer that still aliases the `ColorMapObject` freed while parsing the current image descriptor.
sink.note: The saved trace reports `READ of size 4` at `gifload.c:463:24`, 0 bytes inside a 24-byte region allocated in `GifMakeMapObject` and freed in `DGifGetImageHeader`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. `vips_foreign_load_gif_scan_image()` snapshots `file->Image.ColorMap` into local `map` before calling `DGifGetImageDesc()`, even though giflib may free or replace `GifFile->Image.ColorMap` while parsing the current image.
root_cause.note: The matching fix in local history is `ce684dd00`, which removes this early fetch and re-reads `map` after `DGifGetImageDesc()` returns. The staged `patch.diff` is unrelated and only adds a testcase.

coarse_trace.summary: The harness writes the 50-byte witness to a temporary file and calls `vips_image_new_from_file()`, which routes the file into the GIF loader.
The `GIF8` signature passes libvips' GIF probe, and giflib materializes logical-screen width and height 8224x8224 from witness bytes `20 20 20 20` during GIF open.

Header scanning reaches the first image descriptor, and `DGifGetImageDesc()` materializes first-frame geometry 8224/8224/8224/8224 and allocates a 4-entry local `file->Image.ColorMap` from packed byte `0x99`.

The first frame is rejected as a bad size against the 8224x8224 logical screen before colour scanning or image-data drain, and the header loop ignores that `-1`, consumes leftover byte `0xff` as a wrong record, and then reaches the second image descriptor at offset 37.

On the second image, libvips snapshots the prior `file->Image.ColorMap` into local `map`, giflib frees that object while parsing a 32x32 descriptor with no replacement local map, and the later grayscale loop reads `map->ColorCount` from freed memory.

fine_trace.note: During `DGifOpen()` from `gifload.c:1091`, giflib consumes witness bytes `20 20 20 20` at offsets 4-7. `DGifGetWord()` reads little-endian `0x2020` twice, materializing `GifFile->SWidth = GifFile->SHeight = 8224`, which both later frame-size guards use.

At witness offset 14, `DGifGetRecordType()` reads the first `0x2c` byte and materializes `record = IMAGE_DESC_RECORD_TYPE`, so the header loop dispatches into `vips_foreign_load_gif_scan_image()` for the first image descriptor.

For the first frame, `DGifGetImageDesc()` parses header bytes `20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 99`. `DGifGetWord()` materializes `Left = Top = Width = Height = 0x2020 = 8224`, and packed byte `0x99` sets the local-color-table flag with size code 1, so `DGifGetImageHeader()` allocates a 4-entry `GifFile->Image.ColorMap` and fills it from the 12 bytes at witness offsets 24-35.

fine_trace.note: That first descriptor yields left=8224, top=8224, width=8224, height=8224 on a logical screen of 8224x8224, so the bad-frame-size guard returns `-1` on both `Left + Width > SWidth` and `Top + Height > SHeight`. Control exits before lines 459-469 can test `gif->has_colour`, and before lines 473-476 can drain image data.

The call site in `vips_foreign_load_gif_header()` ignores the `-1` from step 4. Because the first scan returned before `vips_foreign_load_gif_code_next()` consumed image data, the next unread byte in the file is still `0xff` at witness offset 36.

On the next loop iteration, `DGifGetRecordType()` consumes that leftover `0xff`, returns `GIF_ERROR`/`UNDEFINED_RECORD_TYPE`, and line 646 immediately retries the header scan. This one-byte error skip advances the file position to witness offset 37.

poc.trigger: The harness writes the staged 50-byte witness to a temporary file and calls `vips_image_new_from_file(name, "access", VIPS_ACCESS_SEQUENTIAL, NULL)`. giflib first materializes `SWidth = SHeight = 8224` from the logical-screen bytes `20 20 20 20`; header scanning then allocates a local map for a malformed frame, rejects that frame before draining its image data, ignores the `-1`, skips one leftover `0xff` wrong-record byte, and then crashes while scanning the second image descriptor.

format.name: Malformed GIF with two image descriptors
format.contract: A 50-byte GIF-like witness whose first four bytes are `GIF8`, whose logical-screen width and height bytes are both `0x20 0x20`, whose first record byte at offset 14 is `0x2c`, whose first image-header bytes at offsets 15-23 are `20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 99`, whose 12 following bytes at offsets 24-35 populate that first frame's local map, whose next unread byte at offset 36 is `0xff`, and whose later byte at offset 37 is another `0x2c` followed by second image-header bytes `20 00 20 00 20 00 20 00 20`. In that exact layout, the first scan allocates `file->Image.ColorMap` and then returns on the bad-frame-size guard before any `gif->has_colour` update or image-data drain; the second scan snapshots that prior map into local `map`, `DGifGetImageDesc()` frees it and leaves `file->Image.ColorMap == NULL`, and `for( i = 0; i < map->ColorCount; i++ )` dereferences freed memory.
